delta.args_delta: {"reply":{"text":"Thank you for contacting us. We apologise for the inconvenience caused by the flickering and heat issues. We have issued a store credit of €15 (1500 eur in the smallest units) to your account. Please stop using the device until we provide further instructions. The flickering near the controller and the heat problem are covered under warranty. If you need additional help, let us know.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller"},{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch"}]}}
